WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS revenue
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY ProductKey
),
total AS (
    SELECT sum(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM product_revenue
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        revenue,
        sum(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_revenue,
        (SELECT total_revenue FROM total) AS total_revenue
    FROM product_revenue
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        revenue,
        cumulative_revenue,
        total_revenue,
        CASE
            WHEN (cumulative_revenue - revenue) / total_revenue < 0.80 THEN 'A'
            WHEN (cumulative_revenue - revenue) / total_revenue < 0.95 THEN 'B'
            ELSE 'C'
        END AS abc_class
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT
    abc_class,
    count() AS product_count
FROM classified
GROUP BY abc_class
ORDER BY abc_class
